[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the Activating state of Package Manage- ment
⌈
kActivating shall be set when Activate is called. This triggers the depen-
dency check and prepares the processed Software Package to be executed in the
next restart of the machine or Function Group.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating state of Package Manage- ment
⌈
kActivating shall be set when Activate is called. This triggers the depen-
dency check and returns ApplicationError MissingDependencies if this check
fails.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating state of Package Management
⌈
kActivating shall be set when Activate is called. This triggers the dependency
check and returns ApplicationError MissingDependencies if this check fails.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating state of Package Management
⌈
kAc-
tivating shall be set when Activate is called. This triggers the dependency check
and returns ApplicationError MissingDependencies if this check fails.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating state of Package Management
⌈
kAc-
tivating shall be set when Activate is called. This triggers the dependency check
and returns ApplicationError kMissingDependencies if this check fails.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating Update State (updateState) of Package Management
⌈
kActivating shall be set as Update State (updateState) when Activate is
called. This triggers the dependency check and returns ApplicationError kDe-
pendencyMissing if this check fails.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00084] Entering the kActivating Update State (updateState) of Package Management
⌈
kActivating shall be set as Update State (updateState) when Activate is
called. This triggers the dependency check and returns ApplicationError kDe-
pendencyMissing if this check fails.
⌋
